verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an official SDK with install, authentication, and async-call guidance (docs-12), and it sits alongside an API reference (docs-19) and an official CLI (docs-13) for building against the API. The SDK evidence is a single short docs summary, though, so breadth and depth are unverified. Missing for 10: which languages the SDKs cover (the story says SDKs, plural), detailed SDK reference docs or code examples, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
